title.en: Fire dragon and rider over scorched world
title.zh: 火龙与焰骑士掠过焦土世界

description.en: Controls a brief epic of a fire dragon and living-flame rider rising over a scorched world through smoke and sunset.
description.zh: 控制极短史诗画面：火龙与焰骑士穿越烟雾与落日，升上焦土世界。

prompt:
fire dragon and his rider of living flame,
rising over a scorched world, cutting through smoke and sunset.
